primary_task: Design, build, install on PATH and smoke-test a composable JSON CLI (Rust/Node/Python) for a service, plus a companion skill.

requirements.name: cli-toolchain
requirements.evidence: Choose the Runtime: Rust / TypeScript/Node / Python
requirements.check: command -v cargo rustc node pnpm npm python3 uv

requirements.name: target service API
requirements.evidence: at least one fixture, dry-run, or live read-only API call

notes: Target API host and its credentials are user-specific inputs; fixture/dry-run path is allowed so not hard. Python stdlib path requires no extra installs.
